clue.text: Soldier's uniform

as an adjective, even and unvarying throughout

clue.text: Summaries given about headgear

clue.text: Mixing online less creates isolation

indicators.note: mixing tells us to jumble the letters of online less

clue.text: Direct both ways?

parts.note: to direct someone to a source or specialist is to send them on there; the word also reads the same backwards

explanation.walkthrough: The word is a palindrome, so it can be read both ways.
explanation.definitionFit: To direct someone to a specialist or source is to send them on, a synonym.

clue.text: Hard to cry over American

clue.text: Make prisoners terse over time

clue.text: Brain food

definitions.meaning: British slang for the head or mind

explanation.walkthrough: 'Use your loaf' is British slang, from rhyming slang loaf of bread = head.
explanation.definitionFit: Slang for the head or brain, and a baked bread item is plainly food.

clue.text: Won't he do the wrapping precisely?

indicators.note: the words Won't he do the wrap around the hidden answer

explanation.surface: A question about whether someone will wrap gifts exactly.
explanation.definitionFit: An idiom for exactly on time, so precisely is a synonym.

clue.text: Kisses can oddly spread illness

indicators.note: spread means the letters are distributed into a new order
oddly picks the odd-numbered letters of can

explanation.surface: Kissing may pass disease around.
explanation.walkthrough: 'oddly' takes C and N from CAN; 'spread' shuffles these with KISSES.
explanation.definitionFit: Being unwell or ailing is the same as illness.

clue.text: Check container vessel

parts.note: CH is the chess notation abbreviation for check
an urn is a container, for tea or ashes

explanation.surface: An instruction to inspect a container that is a vessel.

clue.text: Great air-cooler finally kept wine cold

parts.note: a fan cools the air

parts.note: Asti is an Italian sparkling wine
C is the abbreviation for cold on taps

clue.text: Regard tree outside university — pity top's chopped off

indicators.note: outside means the tree word goes round the university letter

parts.note: the poplar is a tall tree

explanation.walkthrough: 'top's chopped off' removes P from PITY, leaving ITY.

clue.text: Started to avoid good head

parts.note: began means started

clue.text: Fancy the prom with sea air

indicators.note: fancy as an adjective means elaborate, telling us the letters are rearranged

ructions are rows or noisy disturbances

explanation.walkthrough: INST (instant) is old business-letter usage, as in 'your letter of the 5th inst'.

clue.text: River rising — it starts to inflate old nun's habit

taken as written

explanation.walkthrough: 'habit' looks like the nun's dress; it is the definition, a custom.

clue.text: Friend supporting Spain set to be gutted, I guess

indicators.note: in a down clue, supporting puts the friend word beneath the rest

clue.text: The least bad runners?

indicators.note: bad tells us the letters of the least are rearranged

clue.text: Sister entertains at group's pleasure

parts.note: a faction is a group within a party

clue.text: Cunning to wear the man's suit

art means cunning or craft

clue.text: Sum left Wendy regularly confused

explanation.walkthrough: 'regularly' takes E and D from WENDY.

clue.text: Man, perhaps, is allowed to scratch tail

parts.note: let means allowed

clue.text: I had energy to follow wife and roll out blanket

to spread is to roll out, as a rug

clue.text: Improve pieces penned by editor

clue.text: Short letter from school turned up

parts.note: Eton is a famous English public school

clue.text: Allow writer salary increase right away

parts.note: an author is a writer

clue.text: Chap's mistake to change direction at the end

clue.text: Oriental art seen all over the place

clue.text: Doctor sees wound before daughter is bandaged
